item.title: 遠隔サポート製品「SolarWinds Dameware」に複数の脆弱性
item.description: SolarWindsのリモート操作製品「SolarWinds Dameware」に複数の脆弱性が明らかとなった。遠隔操作先のホストが侵害される深刻な脆弱性も判明しており、同社は修正版を提供している。

item.title: HPEのネットワーク管理製品に複数脆弱性 - 「クリティカル」3件
item.description: HPEのネットワーク管理製品「HPE Networking Fabric Composer」に複数の脆弱性が明らかとなった。深刻な脆弱性も複数含まれており、同社は修正版を提供している。

item.title: OpenAI’s upcoming AI model built 948 working Linux root exploits in a single run
item.description: An automated system running on an upcoming AI model turned hundreds of Linux kernel bugs into working exploits that give an ordinary user root access, and wrote a patch for each underlying flaw, OpenAI revealed in a new research post. Source:OpenAI The company’s Cyber team ran the pipeline in mid-October 2026 against the latest Linux kernel, with target machines running a stock desktop operating system from a commonly used distribution. The run ended with 948 … More → The post OpenAI’s upcoming AI model built 948 working Linux root exploits in a single run appeared first on Help Net Security .

item.title: OpenAI AI Pipeline Generates 948 Linux Root Escalation Exploits in 30-Hour Run
item.description: OpenAI on Wednesday detailed a pipeline that employed an upcoming cyber-focused artificial intelligence (AI) model to validate and patch 948 local privilege escalation vulnerabilities in Linux for $1.2 million in API costs. item.title: Zyxel GS1900 Patch Fails to Block Zero-Day Exploit Allowing Root Command Execution
item.description: Zyxel GS1900 network switches that received the vendor's earlier fix for an actively exploited flaw are still open to the exploit attackers used, researchers at Binarly found. The exploit lets anyone who can reach a switch's web management interface run commands on it without logging in. Zyxel has released new firmware for 10 GS1900 models that closes the hole.
